an3.64:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an3.64:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sarabho nāma paribbājako acirapakkanto hoti imasmā dhammavinayā.
an3.64:1.4: so rājagahe parisatiṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati :
an3.64:1.6: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtikānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti.
an3.64:1.7: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
an3.64:1.8: assosuṃ kho te bhikkhū sarabhassa paribbājakassa rājagahe parisatiṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa :
an3.64:1.10: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti.
an3.64:2.1: atha kho te bhikkhū rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ :
an3.64:2.2: sarabho nāma bhante paribbājako acirapakkanto imasmā dhammavinayā.
an3.64:2.3: so rājagahe parisatiṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati.
an3.64:2.5: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti.
an3.64:2.6: sādhu bhante bhagavā yena sippinikātiraṃ yena paribbājakārāmo, yena sarabho paribbājako, tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an3.64:3.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena sappinikātīraṃ yena paribbājakārāmo yena sarabho paribbājako tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca :
an3.64:3.2: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ sarabha evaṃ vadesi :
an3.64:3.4: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkantoti?
an3.64:3.5: evaṃ vutte sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:4.1: dutiyampi kho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca :
an3.64:4.2: vadehi sarabha, kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo;
an3.64:4.3: sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati, ahaṃ paripūressāmi.
an3.64:4.4: sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati, ahaṃ anumodissāmīti.
an3.64:4.5: dutiyampi kho sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:5.1: tatiyampi kho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca :
an3.64:5.2: vadehi sarabha, kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo,
an3.64:5.3: sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati, ahaṃ paripūressāmi.
an3.64:5.4: sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati, ahaṃ anumodissāmīti.
an3.64:5.5: tatiyampi kho sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:6.1: atha kho te paribbājakā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavocuṃ :
an3.64:6.2: “yadeva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ yāceyyāsi. tadeva te samaṇo gotamo pavāreti.
an3.64:6.3: vadehāvuso sarabha, kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo,
an3.64:6.4: sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati, samaṇo gotamo paripūressati.
an3.64:6.5: sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati, samaṇo gotamo anumodissatīti.
an3.64:6.6: evaṃ vutte sarabho paribbājako tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
an3.64:7.1: atha kho bhagavā sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā te paribbājake etadavoca :
an3.64:8.1: yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya.
an3.64:8.2: sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhāti, tamahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ, samanugāheyyaṃ, samanubhāseyyaṃ.
an3.64:8.3: so vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso, yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissati, tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdissati, seyyathāpi sarabho paribbājako.
an3.64:9.1: yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya :
an3.64:9.2: khīṇāsavassa te paṭijānato ime āsavā aparikkhīṇāti, tamahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanugāheyyaṃ samanubhāseyyaṃ.
an3.64:9.3: so vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya, aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissati, tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdissati, seyyathāpi sarabho paribbājako.
an3.64:10.1: yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya :
an3.64:10.2: yassa kho pana te atthāya dhammo desito, so na niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyāti, tamahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanugāheyyaṃ, samanubhāseyyaṃ.
an3.64:10.3: so vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissati, tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdissati, seyyathāpi sarabho paribbājakoti.
an3.64:10.4: atha kho bhagavā sappinikātīre paribbājakārāme tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā vehāsaṃ pakkāmi.
an3.64:11.1: atha kho te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāsattitodakena sañjambhariṃ akaṃsu :
an3.64:11.2: seyyathāpi āvuso sarabha brahāraññe jarasigālo sīhanādaṃ nadissāmīti segālakaññeva nadati, bheraṇḍakaññeva nadati.
an3.64:11.3: evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha, aññatreva samaṇena gotamena sīhanādaṃ nadissāmīti segālakaññeva nadasi, bheraṇḍakaññeva nadasi.
an3.64:11.4: seyyathāpi āvuso sarabha ambakamaddarī phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmīti ambakamaddariravitaññeva ravati.
an3.64:11.5: evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha aññatreva samaṇena gotamena phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmīti ambakamaddariravitaññeva ravasi.
an3.64:11.6: seyyathāpi āvuso sarabha usabho suññāya gosālāya gambhīraṃ naditabbaṃ maññati.
an3.64:11.7: evameva kho tvaṃ āvuso sarabha, aññatreva samaṇena gotamena gambhīraṃ naditabbaṃ maññasīti.
an3.64:11.8: atha kho te paribbājakā sarabhaṃ paribbābhājakaṃ samantato vācāyasattitodakena sañjambhariṃ
